name: shade-os
description: SHADE OS — deliverable agents for the SHADE Architecture & Design department (part of Shelter Group). Generates branded, house-style deliverables on demand: Material/Finishes Booklets (Word), FF&E / BOQ schedules (Excel), and Selection Presentations (PowerPoint). Uses the SHADE + Shelter Group logos, the monochrome black/white brand, the standard dual-logo header, the QATAR/UAE/LEBANON/KSA/FRANCE/ITALY/RWANDA footer, and SHADE item-coding conventions (e.g. 1B.DT4, 3B.SF, IFF-001).
